definitions.explanation: The act of writing lyrics for a song.

examples.english: Who wrote the lyrics for this song?

examples.japanese: {作詞|さくし}⟦{作曲|さっきょく}→作曲：02824_sakkyoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: The lyrics and music were written by the same person.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{気持|きも}ち→気持ち：01385_kimochi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歌|うた}→歌：02179_uta⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦したくて→する：00392_suru⟧、{作詞|さくし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: I started writing lyrics because I wanted to turn my feelings into songs.

notes:
{作詞|さくし} means writing lyrics or song words. The kanji break down as ⟦{作|さく}→作：27430_saku⟧ (make) + ⟦{詞|し}→詞：noentry⟧ (words/lyrics). It can also function as a ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ verb: {作詞|さくし}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to write lyrics).

COMPOUNDS:
- {作詞|さくし}⟦{家|か}→〜家：28339_ka⟧: lyricist, songwriter
- {作詞|さくし}⟦{作曲|さっきょく}→作曲：02824_sakkyoku⟧: lyrics and composition (by the same person)

MUSIC CREDIT FORMAT:
In Japanese music credits, roles are listed as:
- {作詞|さくし}：〇〇 (Lyrics: 〇〇)
- ⟦{作曲|さっきょく}→作曲：02824_sakkyoku⟧：〇〇 (Music: 〇〇)
- ⟦{編曲|へんきょく}→編曲：05234_henkyoku⟧：〇〇 (Arrangement: 〇〇)

RELATED MUSIC TERMS:
- ⟦{作曲|さっきょく}→作曲：02824_sakkyoku⟧: music composition
- ⟦{編曲|へんきょく}→編曲：05234_henkyoku⟧: arrangement
- ⟦{歌詞|かし}→歌詞：13160_kashi⟧: lyrics (the text itself, not the act of writing)
